# Hotkey field (`hotkey-field`)

Records a keyboard shortcut.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createHotkeyField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/hotkeyField.d.ts`): `.mh-input.mh-hotkey` inside a `.mh-field`: records a keyboard shortcut. The value is a button showing the keys as keycaps; pressing it (or Enter / Space) starts recording (`.is-recording`), the next key with its modifiers becomes the shortcut. Escape or leaving cancels, Tab cancels and moves on, Backspace or Delete removes the shortcut. Progress is announced in a polite live region; a clear button sits at the end.

```ts
export function createHotkeyField(options: HotkeyFieldOptions): HotkeyFieldHandle;

export interface HotkeyFieldOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** The shortcut as canonical text (`Ctrl+Shift+K`, see `hotkeyToString`); empty for none. */
  value?: string;
  /** Shown when there is no shortcut (default "Not set"). */
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Shown while recording (default "Press a shortcut"). */
  recordingText?: string;
  /** Only accept keys held with Ctrl, Alt or Meta (function keys and Shift with a named key count too). */
  requireModifier?: boolean;
  /** Draw ⌃ ⌥ ⇧ ⌘ (default: on Apple devices). */
  appleSymbols?: boolean;
  /** Shows a clear button while a shortcut is set (default true). */
  clearable?: boolean;
  clearLabel?: string;
  name?: string;
  helper?: string;
  error?: string;
  required?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  size?: InputSize;
  labelStyle?: 'label' | 'eyebrow';
  /** Called with the new shortcut's canonical text, or `''` when cleared. */
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
}

export interface HotkeyFieldHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The button that records. */
  control: HTMLButtonElement;
  field: FieldHandle | null;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  isRecording(): boolean;
  startRecording(): void;
  cancelRecording(): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface FieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  label: HTMLLabelElement | HTMLSpanElement;
  /** The described element (input, select, textarea or the control). */
  target: HTMLElement;
  setHelper(text: string | undefined): void;
  setError(text: string | undefined): void;
  setSuccess(text: string | undefined): void;
  /** Updates the counter: `3 / 40` with a max, `3` without. */
  setCount(count: number, max?: number): void;
  /** Dims the label and messages (the control disables itself). */
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`hotkeyFromEvent` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/hotkeyField.d.ts`): The hotkey a key press makes, or `null` for a modifier on its own.

```ts
export function hotkeyFromEvent(event: HotkeyKeyEvent): Hotkey | null;
```

`hotkeyToString` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/hotkeyField.d.ts`): The canonical text of a hotkey: `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Meta+K`, modifiers in that order.

```ts
export function hotkeyToString(k: Hotkey): string;
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createHotkeyField, hotkeyFromEvent, hotkeyToString } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const shortcut = createHotkeyField({
  label: 'Open search',
  value: 'Ctrl+K',
  helper: 'Press the field, then a key combination.',
  onChange: (value) => (status.textContent = value ? `Search opens with ${value}.` : 'No shortcut.'),
});

document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
  if (shortcut.isRecording()) return;
  const pressed = hotkeyFromEvent(event);
  if (pressed && hotkeyToString(pressed) === shortcut.getValue()) {
    event.preventDefault();
    status.textContent = 'Search opened.';
  }
});

document.body.append(shortcut.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { HotkeyField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { hotkeyFromEvent, hotkeyToString } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function HotkeyFieldExample() {
  const [shortcut, setShortcut] = useState('Ctrl+K');
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const pressed = hotkeyFromEvent(event);
      if (shortcut && pressed && hotkeyToString(pressed) === shortcut) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setOpened((n) => n + 1);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [shortcut]);

  return (
    <HotkeyField
      label="Open search"
      helper={opened ? `Search opened ${opened} times.` : 'Press the field, then a key combination.'}
      value={shortcut}
      onChange={setShortcut}
    />
  );
}
```
